message.content:
Build the Blog, Beta, and Testimonials pages for the Boldteq marketing site.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes. Never use `any` type. Read existing components for patterns.

**Read first:**
- `src/app/page.tsx` — composition pattern
- `src/components/our-works/portfolio-grid.tsx` — filter+grid pattern to reuse for blog
- `src/components/shared/page-hero.tsx`, `src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx`
- `src/lib/constants/pricing.ts` — constants pattern
- `CMS Data/Boldteq - Blog Posts - 695f68a83604d0d15b8c9ad8.csv` — blog data

## Blog Page (`/blog`)

### `src/types/blog.ts`
```typescript
export interface BlogPost {
  title: string;
  slug: string;
  image: string;
  shortDescription: string;
  category: string;
}

export interface BlogCategory {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
}
```

### `src/lib/constants/blog.ts`
7 blog posts from CSV:
1. "How Agencies Use White-Label Web Development Teams" — slug: how-agencies-use-white-label-teams-in-practice-6, category: web-development, image: https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6936b27cc4d64679a58e166d/695f69fd56c2e44fd26ba42e_1f99741be431e7b9a1b8d7e4ab585ef77077f493.png, shortDescription: "Practical perspectives on agency growth, white-label delivery, and execution systems — written for teams scaling client work."
2. "How White-Label CRO Services Help Agencies Convert" — slug: how-white-label-cro-services-help-agencies-convert, category: shopify, same shortDescription, image: ...695f6916940a141c62ff83c9_f4f2ffedfaa99fee8f19eb210348959198b2a72a.png
3. "How to Scale Agency Web Dev Without Hiring" — slug: how-to-scale-agency-web-dev-without-hiring, category: web-development, image: ...695f68bdd2ba095a11c95203_c32a98f52cfeeb06e3c9c1ceb0d2ba9ae6c3d1b7.png
4. "White Label vs Outsourcing: What's the Real Difference?" — slug: white-label-vs-outsourcing-whats-the-real-difference, category: ui-ux-design, image: ...695f68d5bc5b1d2faf7c3494_cdcd25abc4147c93ede9d5c0bf1e81ed8f5070ba.png
5-7: Read the remaining posts from the CSV file at `CMS Data/Boldteq - Blog Posts - 695f68a83604d0d15b8c9ad8.csv`

Blog categories: All, CRO, Shopify, UI/UX Design, Web Development, White-Label & Outsourcing, WordPress

### `src/components/blog/blog-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
- H1: "Insights on Scaling Agencies with White-Label Delivery"
- Subtitle: "Practical insights on white-label outsourcing, agency growth, web delivery systems, and conversion-focused execution..."
- 3 stat badges: "Built for Agencies" (`Layer_1-14.svg`), "White-Label Expertise" (`Layer_1-3.svg`), "Execution-Focused" (`Layer_1-15.svg`)
- CTA: "Explore How It Works" → /how-it-works

### `src/components/blog/blog-card.tsx` + `.module.css`
- Props: `{ post: BlogPost }`
- Featured image, category badge, title, short description
- Currently no blog detail pages, so card is not a link (just displays)

### `src/components/blog/blog-grid.tsx` + `.module.css`
"use client" component. Same pattern as portfolio-grid:
- Category filter tabs + search input
- Filters blog posts by category and search
- Grid: 3-col → 2-col → 1-col
- Empty state

### `src/app/blog/page.tsx` — server component with metadata

Page: BlogHero → BlogGrid → CtaBanner

---

## Beta Page (`/beta`)

Read `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/beta.html` for exact content.

### `src/app/beta/page.tsx` — server component

The beta page is essentially a pricing page variant with beta-specific messaging. It has:
1. Hero with "Beta Access" badge, title about founding partner pricing
2. Pricing section (reuse `PricingSection` from home)
3. Blue CTA section (similar to custom-plan-cta)
4. Built-for section (reuse or create a simple "Built for agencies" section)

Since the beta page largely reuses existing components:
```tsx
import { PricingSection } from "@/components/home/pricing-section";
import { CtaBanner } from "@/components/shared/cta-banner";
import { BetaCta } from "@/components/shared/beta-cta";
```

Create a simple `src/components/beta/beta-hero.tsx` + `.module.css` with:
- Badge: "Beta Access"
- H1: "Get Founding Partner Pricing Before Public Launch"
- Subtitle about beta program
- CTA button

Page: BetaHero → PricingSection → CtaBanner → BetaCta

---

## Testimonials Page (`/testimonials`)

### `src/lib/constants/testimonials.ts`
Create a small array of testimonial data. The Webflow testimonials page uses placeholder/repeated data, so create 6 placeholder testimonials with:
- quote, name, role, company

### `src/components/testimonials/testimonials-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
Simple hero with PageHero pattern. Title: "What Agencies Say About Boldteq"

### `src/components/testimonials/testimonial-card.tsx` + `.module.css`
- Props: `{ testimonial: Testimonial }`
- Quote text, name, role, company
- Star rating (5 stars)
- Subtle border + shadow card

### `src/components/testimonials/testimonials-grid.tsx` + `.module.css`
Grid of testimonial cards. 3-col → 2-col → 1-col.

### `src/app/testimonials/page.tsx` — server component

Page: TestimonialsHero → TestimonialsGrid → CtaBanner
